verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a long-running, unattended research job, and nothing says the product notifies the user when a result is ready. The closest item is the ability to delay generations when AI limits are reached. That is a deferral of artifact generation, not an autonomous research job with completion notifications, so it is only adjacent.

support.subject: As an analyst, I can start a long research job that keeps working unattended and notifies me when the result is ready
